source.organization: State Industries Promotion Corporation of Tamil Nadu Limited (SIPCOT)
source.title: Availability of land in SIPCOT industrial parks
capturedFields: plot cost in lakh rupees per acre
source.reuseCaveat: MITO preserves only the two Siruseri factual rows needed for source-backed price interpretation. The source table was not bulk copied and no open-data licence was found during this audit.

tenureEvidence.organization: State Industries Promotion Corporation of Tamil Nadu Limited (SIPCOT)
tenureEvidence.title: Draft Standard Lease Deed
tenureEvidence.interpretation: SIPCOT's standard document describes the plot cost as consideration for use of developed land under a long lease and specifies a 99-year lease term. This schedule is therefore not recorded as a freehold sale transaction.

location.locationEvidence: An official SIPCOT notice identifies Siruseri IT Park as an approximately 800-acre park on Old Mahabalipuram Road.

currentRegistrationAssociation.caveat: The exact park boundary has not been reconciled to a verified registration-village polygon. These park-level rates must not be applied to the whole Siruseri registration village.

administrativeConflict.note: The live SIPCOT land table labels the park's district as Kancheepuram, while SIPCOT's current GIS park index labels Siruseri as Chengalpattu and MITO's registration crosswalk places it under Chengalpattu registration district. MITO preserves the conflicting source labels and does not silently rewrite them.

location.positionalUncertainty: The named OpenStreetMap footprint is publishable and its centroid falls inside SIPCOT's official GIS boundary, but it is about 11.6% smaller by computed area and differs materially in shape. It is not an official, legal, cadastral or complete park boundary.

records.conversionBasis: 780 lakh INR per acre × 100,000 INR per lakh ÷ 43,560 sq ft per acre
records.scopeCaveat: This is a SIPCOT park-level leasehold allotment plot cost, not a market rate, registered sale, guideline value, parcel valuation or village-wide price.

records.conversionBasis: 1,560 lakh INR per acre × 100,000 INR per lakh ÷ 43,560 sq ft per acre
records.scopeCaveat: This is a SIPCOT park-level leasehold allotment plot cost, not a market rate, registered sale, guideline value, parcel valuation or village-wide price.

subsidy.sourceDescription: The live land-details page describes a potential 10% backend land-cost subsidy for category A and B districts, subject to investment and employment conditions.
subsidy.reasonNotApplied: Eligibility and implementation conditions are project-specific; MITO does not assume that a prospective allottee qualifies.

publication.caveat: The two normalized figures are published only as official government allotment plot costs and share one approximate named OSM park footprint. The geometry does not identify either available parcel and the figures do not satisfy MITO's guideline-value or market-transaction release gates.
